name: What are the common challenges when investing in Florida real estate?

mainEntity.name: What are the common challenges when investing in Florida real estate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common challenges include navigating Florida's specific property tax structures, understanding insurance requirements, especially for coastal properties susceptible to hurricanes, and adapting to fluctuating tourism markets for vacation rentals. Competition can also be high in desirable areas like South Beach or Key Biscayne. Investors should also be aware of potential HOA fees and regulations, which can impact profitability. Kelby Contreras provides guidance on these local nuances and helps clients anticipate potential issues unique to different Florida markets.
acceptedAnswer.description: Challenges include property taxes, insurance for coastal properties, tourism fluctuations, and high competition in popular areas. Kelby Contreras can help navigate these specific Florida market issues.
